title: Hosted sandboxes and a new way to get an API key
summary:
Sandboxes, larger media chats, visible model evals, and community-built tools all got a little easier to use.

Developers can run E2B-compatible sandboxes through gen with existing E2B tools, or manage them with `polli sandbox` and connect over SSH. A completed x402 Pollen-pack purchase now returns a budgeted API key; the checkout page shows payment-method examples relevant to the buyer’s country, and the Machines permission label says plainly what it grants.

The chat API now accepts requests up to 100 MiB with large inline images. It also offloads large data URIs in image, video, and file URL fields, reusing account-scoped uploads across turns instead of sending the same bytes again. Which media types work still depends on the model.

Model Monitor has an Evals tab with weekly Alice and Bowls puzzle scores, past runs, official-versus-community comparisons, and margins of error. Eval runs now pace requests to each model’s advertised rate limit and publish the other scores when one model runs out of retries.

highlights.title: Hosted coding sandboxes
highlights.text: Use E2B-compatible sandboxes through `/alpha/e2b`, or manage them with `polli sandbox` and SSH into a template with five coding agents.

highlights.title: Larger media-rich chats
highlights.text: Send chat requests up to 100 MiB with inline images. Large image, video, and file data URIs can use reusable account-scoped uploads through the [chat API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/chat/completions).

highlights.title: Weekly model puzzle rankings
highlights.text: Compare official and community models on seeded puzzle evaluations, browse past runs, and see margins of error in [Model Monitor](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Pollinations for Krita
highlights.text: Generate images on new Krita layers and edit images with this community-made plugin. [View repo](https://github.com/xiaotian1171/pollinations-krita).

highlights.title: Pollinations for Unity
highlights.text: Add chat, image generation, and speech generation to Unity projects with a dependency-free C# package. [View repo](https://github.com/Marcus-Mok-GH/pollinations-unity).
